answer: An agent economy can resist Sybils with a refundable opal bond: each identity locks stake that vests slowly, while peers whisper-check random samples of its work. The fable of free fakes fails because each fake needs its own bond, compute, and audit trail, and a failed check slashes it. Forging N identities costs N bonds plus N verification trails, while one honest identity reuses one bond, so scale itself becomes the attacker bill.
